faq_items.q1: How do I add a new product to my store?
faq_items.a1: Navigate to the Products tab in your dashboard and click the '+' or 'Add Product' button. Fill in the product details, upload high-quality images, set your price, and save to publish it to your store.
faq_items.q2: How do I track my delivery orders?
faq_items.a2: Go to Settings > Delivery Orders. There you will find three tabs categorizing your orders into Pending, Completed, and Returns. You can view full details by expanding any order card.
faq_items.q3: When do I get paid for a sale?
faq_items.a3: Payments are settled to your registered bank account or mobile wallet automatically within 24 to 48 hours after an order is successfully delivered and marked as 'Completed'.
faq_items.q4: Can I manage multiple business branches?
faq_items.a4: Yes, you can manage multiple branches. Go to Settings > Business tools and controls, where you can add new business branches and switch between different account types.
